##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the southern North Sea, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling North or Northwest 4 or 5 tonight or at first tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate tonight or tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light rain and drizzle for a time tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in any light rain and drizzle tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 4 or 5, soon decreasing North or Northeast 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
